headline: Google AI leaders Jeff Dean and others launch new startup Discovery Loop
summary: Former Google executives, including AI pioneer Jeff Dean, have left to found Discovery Loop, a public benefit corporation aiming to accelerate scientific research using advanced AI.
details: Jeff Dean, a pivotal figure at Google for over two decades, is departing the tech giant to co-found a new AI startup named Discovery Loop. He is joined by several other prominent researchers from Google, including Sanjay Ghemawat, Quoc Le, and Oriol Vinyals.

Discovery Loop is established as a public benefit corporation with the ambitious goal of using AI to significantly speed up scientific research. The startup plans to employ sophisticated algorithms to run thousands of experiments concurrently, aiming to automate parts of the research process and expand experimental capabilities.

The company also intends to explore the use of AI for recursive self-improvement, a process where AI systems enhance their own capabilities, potentially removing human iteration from the discovery loop entirely. This could revolutionize how scientific breakthroughs are made.

The founding team stated, 'The next great frontier for AI is to go beyond answering questions and to begin making discoveries.' They believe that by accelerating engineering and scientific discovery, transformative technologies can be brought to the world much faster.

Dean, who was among Google's earliest employees, has made significant contributions to Google Search's infrastructure and played a key role in developing Google Gemini's multimodal models and early AI research.

Discovery Loop has secured initial funding co-led by Radical Ventures and Khosla Ventures, with participation from Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed, and Doerr Capital. Google's parent company, Alphabet, has also provided financial support.

headline: Meta launches Muse Code, an AI coding agent for macOS and Linux
summary: Meta enters the AI coding assistant market with Muse Code, a new terminal-based tool currently in beta for macOS and Linux.
details: Meta has officially entered the competitive AI coding agent space with the launch of Muse Code. This new tool is designed to assist developers directly within their terminal environments.
Muse Code is currently available in a beta phase and supports both macOS and Linux operating systems. Its integration into the terminal aims to streamline coding workflows for developers.

This release positions Meta alongside other major tech players developing AI-powered coding assistants. The company also announced updates to its Muse Spark model, indicating ongoing development in its AI research.
